experiments.study_type: conditional deletion of Argonaute2 in glutamatergic neurons
experiments.procedure_text: Slc17a6-Cre-expressing mice were crossed to Argonaute2-floxed mice to generate conditional knockout mice. Phenotypic, vascular, and molecular characterization performed at P14.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: Slc17a6-Cre-and Slc32a1-Creexpressing mice were purchased... and directly crossed to Argonaute2-floxed mice

endpoints.label: body weight curves
endpoints.evidence: Body weight curves of Slc17a6-cre, Ago2 flox/flox mice (n = 19) and littermate controls (n = 5).

endpoints.label: survival curve
endpoints.evidence: Survival curve of Slc17a6-cre, Ago2 flox/flox mice

endpoints.label: cortical thickness
endpoints.evidence: reduced cortical thicknesses in Slc17a6cre, Ago2 flox/flox mice

endpoints.label: synaptogenesis
endpoints.evidence: Loss of glutamatergic Ago2 reduces synaptogenesis.

endpoints.label: vascular morphogenesis
endpoints.evidence: Glutamatergic Ago2 is essential for normal vascular morphogenesis in the CNS.

endpoints.label: permeability assay
endpoints.evidence: For the permeability assay, 40 μl of Alexa Fluor 555-conjugated cadaverine... was injected intraperitoneally

experiments.exposure_evidence: 40 μl of Alexa Fluor 555-conjugated cadaverine (1 mg/ml... was injected intraperitoneally into P14 postnatal mice.
experiments.regulatory_evidence: in accordance with requirements established by the Johns Hopkins University Animal Care and Use Committee
experiments.notes: Experiments involved genetic modification (conditional knockout) rather than pharmacological administration, except for the cadaverine permeability assay.
